channelTitle: Why Grandma June keeps a little cloth pouch under her pillow
hook: No pills, no apps, just a small pouch of dried flowers tucked under the pillowcase.
remedy: A small sachet of dried lavender tucked under the pillow is an old-fashioned trick for a calmer bedroom and an easier time drifting off to sleep.
steps: Fill a small breathable cloth pouch with dried lavender buds
Tie or sew it closed so nothing spills out
Slip it under your pillowcase or near your headboard at bedtime
caution: Keep sachets away from very young children and pets who might chew on them.
cta: Do you use lavender for sleep, or do you have a different scent you swear by? Tell Grandma June in the comments.
